data: ../opening_validation_raw.json.gz; all sessions previously consumed; no new holdout
candidate: Volatility-scaled directional change on closed 5m prices. Start after 6 complete bars. Reversal requires max(5 points, prior 6-bar mean true range), frozen when the running closing-price extreme updates. Signal direction switches only on threshold crossing. Update state on every bar; emit at most once per 30m, suppressing changes inside cooldown without re-emitting later.
true_range: Within-session high-low and gaps to prior close; decision bar excluded from ATR. No cross-session warmup or imputation.
execution: Next available raw bar open at/after decision+latency. Stop 1R from actual assumed fill, target 2R, R=max(5, prior ATR6 at decision), hold 30m from fill. Complete same-session horizon required. Gap stops fill at worse opening; ambiguous bars report bounds. Index-point simulation only.
reference_legs: Retrospective 10-point directional-change segmentation of ALL 5m closing prices. Keep legs >=20 points. Append terminal unfinished leg explicitly flagged. Pivot timestamps belong to bar CLOSE, not bar start. Reference never feeds detection.
coverage: One-to-one chronological match: first still-unmatched same-side candidate in [leg start,leg end) and before 75% of leg closing-price displacement is consumed. Early subset <=25% consumed. Report time lag and consumed points. Do not match signals from before the retrospective start. Coverage is descriptive hindsight alignment, not advance prediction.
baselines: Always up and reversed direction at candidate times, same R/latency/rules. Additionally 1000 within-session direction permutations preserving counts; cache both-direction outcomes. Compare net points at cost 1, include all draws, seed 711.
uncertainty: 1000 paired session bootstraps candidate minus mean randomized baseline, 95% descriptive interval; seed 712. Both time blocks before/on-after 2026-09-14 previously used; granularity confounded with split.
decision: No adoption on consumed data. Candidate advances only to unused prospective testing if zero-latency net at cost 1 is positive in both blocks AND paired candidate-minus-random 95% lower bound is positive. Otherwise suspend this parameterization. No tuning after results.
source_provenance: Inherited archived SPX dataset without independently verified contract/source stamps; never LIVE_VERIFIED. Regular XNYS session only.
frozen_system: No changes to frozen weights, threshold, state, alert routes, schedules, main or deployments. New rule remains offline.
